en.abdullah-al-shahin: (3) Ali bin Ahmad narrated from Obaydillah bin Musa al-Alawi from Ya’qoob bin Yazeed from Muhammad bin Abu Omayr from Abdullah bin Bukayr from Muhammad bin Muslim
that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “O Muhammad, whoever narrates to you a tradition from us talking about timing, do not hesitate to consider him as a liar because we do not time to anyone.”
